Name: Plus Alive Harvey - Content Patcher
Author: Azurysu
Description:
[left][size=3]﻿
Ever felt that Harvey needs more content in-game? So did I! [/size]I'm learning how to make mods for Stardew Valley for this purpose! Plus Alive Harvey adds new stuff like new heart events for the awkward doctor, as well as it extends all the vanilla ones and adds a lot of new dialogue!
[size=3]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/pp8PTvk2/plus-alive-harvey.png[/img][/size]
[size=2]This mod aims to expand on Harvey's personality, adding new heart events where you'll get to know more about the shy yet loveable doctor, +150 new dialogue lines and many more things that'll come in the future. This mod is currently a work in progress, so not everything is still added... But it will eventually be!

[/size][b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/gnRGJps5/content-inside-the-mod.png[/img]﻿
[/b][size=3]This mod adds:[/size]

[list]
[*][size=2]+150 different dialogue lines for Harvey (for the 1st and 2nd year, with some extra lines for the 3rd!), including new marriage dialogue![/size]
[*][size=2]Tweaks a bunch of dialogue Harvey had that may have been a bit out of his character (for me, personally) and may have felt awkward or even creepy to some players, like the "canon" pairing between him and Maru. They have been reworked so he's now more of a mentor figure to her. Similar to what [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30024?tab=description]No Harvey x Maru [/url]﻿or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20238]Less Creepy Harvey[/url]﻿ does![/size]
[*][size=2]Most heart events from the base game have been modified/extended [b](6h, 8h, 10, and 14h)[/b]; the dialogues have been modified to give him more personality, and even some events have been expanded further![/size]
[*][size=2]New heart events that delve further into Harvey's personality and backstory [b](3h, 5h and 11h). [/b]This dork is a huge fan of airplanes.[/size]
[*][size=2]Harvey now has different reactions when the farmer faints and ends up on the hospital, depending on their relationship.[/size]
[*][size=2]His friends and some Pelican Town residents will now casually comment from time to time about your relationship and after his heart events.[/size]
[*][size=2]6 new custom portraits![/size]
[*][size=2]Dialogue changes depending on the farmer's gender, including a non-binary option too if you use a mod that adds NB as an option.[/size]
[*][size=2]Letters that Harvey will send you from time to time to your mailbox.[/size]
[*][size=2]Sappy dialogues bc I'm a loser for this man [/size][size=1]help[/size]
[/list]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/CzDw10Jg/future-mod-content.png[/img]﻿

[size=3]Since this is a work in progress, not everything has been added to the mod (yet). This is what I plan to add to Plus Alive Harvey, eventually:
[/size]
[list]
[*]Modified versions of all base game's heart events
[*]More dialogue lines for years 1 to 3!
[*]More custom portraits for Harvey
[*]New main heart events [b](7h and 9h)[/b] as well as some minor ones. [size=1]Creating events is making me suffer a lot :([/size]
[*]Special heart event in Ginger Island
[*][s]Harvey sending letters to the player depending on their heart level[/s]
[*]New crops, food and quests for Harvey
[*]New objects to place for your house, like plane models!
[*]Full compatibility with SVE (Stardew Valley Expanded)
[*]Actually getting Harvey's pasta primavera recipe after 14h lol
[*][size=2]Add a special event at 13h where Harvey takes the player outside of Pelican Town [/size][size=1](to where? It's a surprise :) )[/size]
[/list][size=2]
[/size][size=3][b]Those crossed out means they are already implemented! [/b][/size][size=2]For now there's not as many content as I wish the mod had; I don't have much free time, and I really wanted to post the mod and receive feedback in order to complete the missing content as best as I can. So please be patient! Be sure I'll update the mod whenever neccesary.
[/size]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/VdMz6w4P/heart-events.png[/img]﻿
[size=2]All the base game/vanilla events still have the same conditions as before.
[/size]
[size=4]Main events[/size]
[spoiler]

[list]
[*]﻿[b]3 hearts: [/b]Location: Clinic. Conditions: It must be a day where Harvey is working at the clinic. Hour: 9am - 3 pm.
[/list]
[list]
[*]﻿[b]5 hearts: [/b]Location: Town. Conditions: Sunny day, it must be a day where Harvey is working at the clinic. Hour: 12pm - 5 pm.
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]11 hearts:[/b] Location: Harvey's Room. Conditions: The player must be married or engaged to Harvey. Hour: anytime on the day.
[/list]
[/spoiler]

[size=3]Other events[/size]
[spoiler]

[list]
[*][b]Harvey's birthday:[/b] Location: Saloon. Conditions: It must be Harvey's birthday (14th Winter). Hour: 4pm - 12 am. [i]This event will change depending on your relationship with the doctor- there's up to four possible variations! (Friends, crush, dating and engaged/married). If you don't want to spoil yourself any more, don't click the spoiler tab![/i]
[/list] [spoiler]
[b] ﻿[/b][b]Friends:[/b] Have at least 5 hearts with Harvey, up to 7 hearts.
[b]﻿Crush:[/b] Have at least 8 hearts with Harvey, up to 10 hearts. Must not be dating him.
[b]﻿Dating:[/b] Be dating him (duh)
[b]﻿Engaged/Married: [/b]Be engaged or married to him (duh x2)
[/spoiler]

[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/QdqhB0bH/PAH-letters.png[/img]﻿

Harvey will send you letters from time to time; usually after an important heart event! If you want to check out when, click on the spoiler tab. Although I recommend you discover them all by yourself!
[spoiler]
You'll receive a letter the morning after the following Heart Events:[list]
[*]3h
[*]6h
[*]8h
[*]11h
[/list][/spoiler]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/6yRB3KzJ/i18n.png[/img]﻿

[size=3]Available languages as of 1.15: [img]https://www.nexusmods.com/assets/images/flags/es.gif[/img]﻿ [img]https://www.nexusmods.com/assets/images/flags/ru.gif[/img][/size][size=2]

Thank you [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/194429937-sasdsdfsghewgfsdhregsdh/]Sasdsdfsghewgfsdhregsdh[/url]﻿ for the russian translation!
[/size]
[size=3][b]This mod has been made with i18n in mind, so it's possible to translate the files to as many languages as the game allows.
[/b][/size][size=2][b][/b] [i]Please keep in mind I'm not an english native speaker, so there may be some grammar mistakes in the English version! [/i]If you see anything wrong or want to suggest a better way to phrase a dialogue, please feel free to tell me so in the comments and I'll look into it.[/size]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/crYdHWTd/mod-compatibility.png[/img]﻿

[size=3]This mods works with[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30024]No Harvey x Maru[/url]﻿,[/b][b][size=3] [/size][/b][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28624]Harvey Attends Aerobics[/url]﻿[b],[/b][/size][b][size=3] [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35038]CSS' Harvey Cares[/url]﻿, [/b][/size][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿!
[/size]

[size=2]Portrait mods work with this mod, but since it adds 6 new custom portraits the mods they might not have those in their files. If you want to add these to your mod and tweak the portraits to your liking, feel free to do so. [i]I'd love to see your take on them! :)[/i][/size]
[size=3][/size][size=2]
It's highly likely that this mod [b]may not work with other content packs/mods that add more content to Harvey[/b]. This is because there's some overlaps in the new content and both packs may rewrite things from one another. I still have to test it fully!
[/size][size=3][size=2]
[/size][img]https://i.postimg.cc/dLdJ1FnK/feedback.png[/img]
I would love to hear some feedback from you!

[/size][size=2]If you have any questions, want to warn about any bug the mod may have or you have any suggestion for new content, please feel free to tell me on the comments or through DMs! Hope you enjoy the mod :)
[/size][/left]
